newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol says LPG cap cancel effect to be seen in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Repsol says LPG cap cancel effect to be seen in Q4.

text.p: Spanish energy group Repsol SA said on Monday that the removal of the price freeze on liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) would boost results in the fourth quarter, as this was when butane consumption rises because of seasonal factors.
In any case, the firm was expecting the news.
"As regards the future, the effect (of removing the price cap) will be seen in the last quarter, when consumption is substantial again," a spokesman told Reuters.
"It's not a surprise because the end of the LPG freeze was foreseen in a (government) decree in January," he added.
The effect of the cap on results was around 20 billion pesetas up to the first quarter of this year, he said.
